title: Last visit to Saddam Hussein before the Iraq bombing

tellings.quote: But when it became clear, when it was already certain there would be bombings and that Saddam Hussein would be killed, I flew to him.

plain: In 2003, once it was certain that Iraq would be bombed and Saddam Hussein killed, a Russian official flew to Baghdad to see Saddam one last time. The guest who tells this is the former president of a republic within Russia, who says he made the trip himself: "I flew to him." He also names Saddam's son Qusay Hussein and Boris Yeltsin as he tells it, and the story shows how close to world leaders he says he was.
